head.t: Framework ending 30 July 2027: External Defibrillation Devices and Related Services and Accessories
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "CorMed-DX". 21 suppliers on the framework. Lot 1 per Find a Tender contract award notice 050296-2025 (the contract launch brief itself publishes no per-supplier lot breakdown). Lot source read 2026-11-15.
